remaining_open_items: Default Molex reference physical mapping and CD switch differ; do not substitute the Hirose footprint.
Data-interface and card-current behavior require a bound card, not just the socket.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Default physical binding unresolved; SD protocol not simulable. Resolution: Resolvable only as an explicit alternate (Hirose DM3AT-SF-PEJM5 push-push), not the default Molex 1040310811 push-pull. Archived DM3 catalogue p3 labels #1(DAT2) #2(CD/DAT3) #3(CMD) #4(VDD) #5(CLK) #6(VSS) #7(DAT0) #8(DAT1) and the card-detection switch contacts (A)/(B), closed with a card inserted. p2 gives current rating 0.5 A, voltage rating 125 V AC, contact resistance 100 mOhm max initial at 1 mA, and Note 1 says the -25..85 C range includes temperature rise caused by current flow. In the card-inserted state the detect switch is closed, so CD_A and CD_B are constrained to one net (ideal closure; its resistance is unsourced).
